en.headline: Simmi Chan takes Hong Kong’s first squash medal with Asian Games bronze
en.dek: Chan Sin-yuk fell in straight games to Malaysia’s Sivasangari Subramaniam in the women’s singles semi-final on Saturday and shares the bronze with Japan’s Satomi Watanabe.
body: Hong Kong’s Simmi Chan Sin-yuk claimed the city’s first squash medal of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Saturday, taking bronze after a straight-games defeat to Malaysia’s Sivasangari Subramaniam in the women’s singles semi-final.
The best-of-five match lasted 26 minutes. Subramaniam took the opening game 11-6. Chan led 7-3 in the second before the Malaysian recovered to win 11-8, then closed out the third 11-7.
There is no third-place match, so Chan shares the bronze with Japan’s Satomi Watanabe, who lost the other semi-final to India’s Anahat Singh. Subramaniam will meet Singh in Sunday’s final.
Hong Kong is already guaranteed gold and silver in the mixed doubles final on Sunday after both of its pairs reached the last two. Team events begin on Monday.

zh.headline: 陳善鈺亞運壁球女單奪銅 港隊壁球開齋
zh.dek: 陳善鈺周六在女單四強直落三局不敵馬來西亞蘇巴拉曼尼安，與日本渡邊聡美並列銅牌。
body: 港隊陳善鈺周六在名古屋亞運壁球女單四強直落三局不敵馬來西亞的蘇巴拉曼尼安，為港隊奪得今屆亞運首面壁球獎牌，並列銅牌。
五局三勝制賽事僅用時26分鐘。蘇巴拉曼尼安先以11比6取勝，第二局陳善鈺一度領先7比3，但被對手追成11比8，第三局再以7比11落敗。
賽事不設銅牌戰，陳善鈺與另一場四強負方、日本的渡邊聡美並列銅牌。蘇巴拉曼尼安將於周日決賽對印度的阿娜哈特·辛格。
港隊混雙兩對組合已晉級決賽，周日將包辦金銀牌。團體賽周一展開。
